scenes.title:
A toast.
No free hands.
points: A glass in one hand, a mic in the other
Eyes on the couple, not on note cards
The talk has to live in your head
sentences: Your best friend's wedding is on Saturday, and you're giving a two-minute toast.
You'll be holding a glass and a microphone, and you want your eyes on the couple, not on note cards.
So the talk has to live in your head.

scenes.title:
Memory
lives in places.
points: The method of loci
Each beat becomes an odd object
Left along a route you know
sentences: Memory champions don't repeat lists. They walk through a place they know and leave a vivid image at each spot.
In a 2017 study in Neuron, six weeks of this method more than doubled ordinary people's recall.
Walk Your Talk brings that trick into your actual room, on SPECS.

scenes.title:
Drop each beat
on a real spot.
points: Five beats, five glowing spots
Pinch to drop a vivid object
A route appears on the floor
sentences: Pinch the glowing spot, and the first beat, thank everyone for coming, becomes a sunflower bouquet on the kitchen island.
The camping trip becomes a tent, the bowling alley a giant pin, patience a golden snail, and the toast itself a champagne flute.
A gold route joins them in the order you'll speak.

scenes.title:
Rehearse with
your feet.
points: Walk up to each object
Its beat appears, then fades
Say it out loud, hands free
sentences: Now walk the route.
As you reach each object, it wakes up and shows its beat, just long enough to say it out loud.
If the next spot is out of view, a small arrow and a soft chime point the way.
Can't walk the room? Pinch the next spot instead.

scenes.title:
Walk it again,
without the words.
points: Objects hide behind a question mark
Say the beat, then check
Grade yourself honestly
sentences: Then the objects hide.
Walk the route again, say each beat from memory, and pinch the question mark to check.
Got it, or missed: two big targets, right next to the object.

scenes.title:
Practice only
what slipped.
points: The first-pass score stays honest
A route of just the missed beats
Walk until every beat is back
sentences: Here, four of five came back.
The debrief names the one that slipped, and builds a practice route with only that beat.
One more walk, and every beat is back.

scenes.title:
Planned, built,
tested in preview.
points: Planned with Devpost Learn's plan-lens
Built with CLAD and the Lens Studio MCP
Objects from Lens Studio's 3D generator
sentences: I planned it with the Devpost Learn plan-lens skill, and built it with CLAD through the Lens Studio MCP.
The five objects come from Lens Studio's 3D generator, and the sounds from CLAD's synthesizer.
Ten logic tests and seven LEAF scenarios pass in the preview, covering every done criterion.

scenes.title:
Your room.
Your talk.
points: Demo: a simulated room in the preview
On glasses: pinch your own furniture
Next: your own talk, palaces that persist
sentences: This demo runs in Lens Studio's preview, in a simulated room, with spots placed on its furniture.
On glasses, you'd pinch your own.
Next, type or say your own talk, and keep your palace between rehearsals.
Walk your talk, and keep your eyes on the people you're talking to.
